description: This file contains utility methods related to Android platform version checks and enabling strict mode for debugging within an Android contacts list application.

classes.name: Utils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for Android version checks and enabling strict mode during debugging.

methods.name: enableStrictMode
methods.description: Enables Android's strict mode policies for thread and VM, useful during debugging to catch potential bugs and leaks.

methods.name: hasGingerbread
methods.description: Checks if the device's Android version is Gingerbread (API level 9) or later.

methods.name: hasHoneycomb
methods.description: Checks if the device's Android version is Honeycomb (API level 11) or later.

methods.name: hasHoneycombMR1
methods.description: Checks if the device's Android version is Honeycomb MR1 (API level 12) or later.

methods.name: hasICS
methods.description: Checks if the device's Android version is Ice Cream Sandwich (API level 14) or later.
